\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 189-190 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:MR-R192-first-pass-words-from-chapters-189-190}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a contract and an interview.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item danger, a favour, hard work, a benefit, a loss
  \item the neighbourhood, traffic, a passenger, a queue, a crowd
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Danger? (\textbf{\mr{धोका}}, \emph{dhokā}.) A favour? (\textbf{\mr{उपकार}}, \emph{upkār}.) Hard work? (\textbf{\mr{कष्ट}}, \emph{kaṣṭa}.) A benefit? (\textbf{\mr{फायदा}}, \emph{phāydā}.) A loss? (\textbf{\mr{तोटा}}, \emph{toṭā}.) The neighbourhood? (\textbf{\mr{शेजार}}, \emph{śejār}.) Traffic? (\textbf{\mr{वाहतूक}}, \emph{vāhtūk}.) A passenger? (\textbf{\mr{प्रवासी}}, \emph{pravāsī}.) A queue? (\textbf{\mr{रांग}}, \emph{rāṅg}.) A crowd? (\textbf{\mr{गर्दी}}, \emph{gardī}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 191-192 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:MR-R192-second-pass-words-from-chapters-191-192}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a manager and a secretary.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a manager, a secretary, accounts, details, information
  \item a company, a colleague, a meeting, a contract, an interview
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A manager? (\textbf{\mr{व्यवस्थापक}}, \emph{vyavasthāpak}.) A secretary? (\textbf{\mr{सचिव}}, \emph{saciv}.) Accounts? (\textbf{\mr{हिशेब}}, \emph{hiśeb}.) Details? (\textbf{\mr{तपशील}}, \emph{tapśīl}.) Information? (\textbf{\mr{माहिती}}, \emph{māhitī}.) A company? (\textbf{\mr{कंपनी}}, \emph{kampanī}.) A colleague? (\textbf{\mr{सहकारी}}, \emph{sahakārī}.) A meeting? (\textbf{\mr{बैठक}}, \emph{baiṭhak}.) A contract? (\textbf{\mr{करार}}, \emph{karār}.) An interview? (\textbf{\mr{मुलाखत}}, \emph{mulākhat}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
